decision: Descriptive regrade of frozen responses. No skill or grader tuning during execution. Existing scores are retained. Primary comparisons use cases complete across all ten configurations and both judges; incomplete coverage is reported separately. Audits never enter performance.
limitations: The original holdout is a retrospective regrade, not a fresh validation of the revised judge. Both judges are Codex models. The rubric reflects explicit user preferences but has not been validated against independent human labels. Model choices remain fallible.
